question_en: As of recent years, how many times has an Egyptian film been nominated for the Oscar for Best International Feature Film?
question_ar: لحد دلوقتي، فيلم مصري اترشح كام مرة لأوسكار أفضل فيلم دولي؟
explanation_en: Despite submitting many films over the decades, Egypt has never received a nomination in this category.
explanation_ar: مصر رشحت أفلام كتير على مر العصور بس ولا مرة دخلت الترشيحات في الفئة دي.

question_en: Ahmed Zaki portrayed President Gamal Abdel Nasser in which 1996 biopic?
question_ar: أحمد زكي جسد شخصية الرئيس جمال عبدالناصر في إيه فيلم سيرة ذاتية سنة 1996؟

question_en: Ahmed Zaki also portrayed President Anwar Sadat in which 2001 film?

question_en: Lebanese director Nadine Labaki's Oscar-nominated film "Capernaum" (2018) follows a boy who does what?

Searches for a lost sibling abroad
options.ar: بيدور على أخوه الضايع بره البلد

explanation_en: The boy sues his parents for giving him life without being able to care for him.

question_en: By common estimates, Adel Imam has appeared in roughly how many films over his career?

explanation_en: Adel Imam had an early supporting role in Chahine's "Iskandariya... Leh?" (1979).

question_en: Which director has made hit adaptations of novels by both Ahmed Mourad ("El Feel El Azraq") and Alaa Al Aswany ("The Yacoubian Building")?
question_ar: مين المخرج اللي عمل أفلام ناجحة من روايات أحمد مراد ("الفيل الأزرق") وعلاء الأسواني ("عمارة يعقوبيان")؟

question_en: Which director helmed the big 2019 ensemble hit "El Kenz" (The Treasure)?
question_ar: مين المخرج اللي عمل فيلم "الكنز" الجماعي الكبير سنة 2019؟

question_en: "Sheikh Jackson" was submitted as Egypt's entry for the Oscars ceremony held in which year?

question_en: The Cairo International Film Festival, launched in 1976, holds what distinction in Africa and the Arab world?

question_en: Which veteran screenwriter wrote the screenplay adaptation of "The Yacoubian Building" (2006)?

question_en: "The Yacoubian Building" (2006) was which director's debut feature film?

question_en: "El Kenz" (The Treasure) was released during which season, when Egyptian blockbusters typically compete for the biggest audiences?

question_en: Ahmed Zaki's final film role, released after his death in 2005, was a biopic of which legendary singer?
